# Organizr

> Organizr is a personal desktop planner for macOS and Windows. All data stays locally on the user's device — no cloud, no mandatory subscription.

## What is Organizr

Organizr brings together in a single desktop app: personal kanban board, habit tracker, workout tracker, nutrition diary, body measurement tracking, goal management, subscription tracker, wardrobe organizer, reading library and file manager. It is designed for people who want a complete personal hub without using dozens of separate apps.

## Platforms

- macOS (Apple Silicon and Intel)
- Windows 10 / 11

## Versions and pricing

- **Organizr Lite** — free, core features
- **Organizr Pro** — €7.49/year (72% off standard price)
- **Organizr Lifetime** — €24.49 one-time payment

## Key features

- **Board (Kanban)** — task and personal project management with customizable columns
- **Tracker** — daily habit tracker with streaks and statistics
- **Workout** — workout log with sets, reps, weight; Hevy integration
- **Nutrition** — nutrition diary with macros; FatSecret integration
- **Measurements** — body weight, BMI and measurements tracking over time
- **Goals** — goal setting and tracking with milestones
- **Subscriptions** — manage and calculate active subscription costs
- **Wardrobe** — clothing item organization
- **Reading** — personal library with reading status and notes
- **Files** — file manager integrated in the hub

## Privacy and data

All data is saved locally on the user's device. Organizr requires no account, sends no data to remote servers and has no access to the user's personal data.
